verdict.rationale: Cash-management automation is a fair question for a business account product, but the evidence pack never documents automatic top-ups between balances or low-balance alerts. Multi-currency balances and general webhook subscriptions are adjacent building blocks a developer could use to construct this, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts
